title: ValidationResult
description: Outcome of one Rust validate job attempt on a draft (OQ-02 section 4), in one of two forms: a seed, which has no parent, or a revision, which names its parent_hash. The job runs the shared strategy validator and checks that the longest lookback fits the cohort warm-up. For a revision it also recomputes the leaf difference from the parent and classifies its change scope (OQ-02 section 3.1). A seed has no rule changes and no change scope. draft_digest is the digest of the draft strategy-artefact/1 the job read; it is not a Strategy Version hash, because no version is registered before validation passes. An accepted VALID or INVALID result makes the job COMPLETED. A VALID result registers the draft as a Strategy Version in DRAFT: a seed, or a revision whose change scope is ENTRY or EXIT. A revision with any other change scope is INVALID with REVISION_SCOPE. A draft that fails validation receives diagnostics, not critique, and no Strategy Version is registered from it; the diagnostics of a revision go to the next proposer attempt (OQ-05 section 4). duration is the attempt duration that the batch host measured; the API settles the attempt's compute reservation from it (OQ-05 section 4).

SeedValidation.title: SeedValidation
SeedValidation.description: Validation of a seed draft. It has no parent_hash.

RevisionValidation.title: RevisionValidation
RevisionValidation.description: Validation of a revision draft. parent_hash is the Strategy Version hash of its parent.

ValidSeed.title: ValidSeed
ValidSeed.description: A valid seed. It has no rule changes and no change scope.

ValidRevision.title: ValidRevision
ValidRevision.description: A valid controlled revision. computed_changes is the leaf difference from the parent that Rust computed over every member except strategy_id, version and parent, which identify the version; it equals the declared changes. change_scope classifies computed_changes by dependency (OQ-02 section 3.1).

ChangeScope.title: ChangeScope
ChangeScope.description: The rule a controlled revision changes, by dependency (OQ-02 section 3.1). A change under /definition/entry affects the entry rule and a change under /definition/exits the exit rules. A changed indicator counts as a change to every rule that references it, directly or through other indicators. Every other change is outside a controlled revision: a change under /definition/selection, /definition/sizing or /definition/execution, a change to an indicator that no entry or exit rule references, and a change outside /definition, such as the operator_set or the contract text. ENTRY: every change affects only the entry rule. EXIT: every change affects only the exit rules. A revision with no change, with changes that affect both, or with a change outside a controlled revision is INVALID with REVISION_SCOPE and is not registered.

ValidationDiagnostic.title: ValidationDiagnostic
ValidationDiagnostic.description: pointer is a JSON Pointer into the strategy artefact, or empty for the whole artefact.

ValidationCode.title: ValidationCode
ValidationCode.description: Strategy failure codes of the shared validator, plus the derived checks. LOOKBACK_EXCEEDS_WARMUP: the longest lookback is longer than the warm-up. LINEAGE_MISMATCH: the declared changes differ from the computed leaf difference. IDENTITY_MISMATCH: a hash does not match its artefact. REVISION_SCOPE: a revision is not a controlled revision: it has no change, its changes affect both the entry rule and the exit rules, or a change is outside a controlled revision (ChangeScope). pointer is the path of the first change outside a controlled revision, or empty; detail names the rules the changes affect.
